# RAEVR

RAEVR is an independent AI studio.

RAEVR designs and builds AI agents, mobile products, data pipelines and decision systems. The studio prioritises working software, explicit constraints and delivery validation.

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://raevr.com/
- About: https://raevr.com/about/
- Work: https://raevr.com/work/
- Services and engagement: https://raevr.com/services/
- Contact: https://raevr.com/contact/

## Public work notes

- Consumer iOS application using live AI agent loops for discovery and recommendation.
- Automated product-catalogue pipeline handling more than 100,000 items across multiple content-management systems.
- Monitoring agent delivering real-time alerts to WhatsApp.
- Internal QA system simulating client expectations before delivery.
